Method of Attack: Disables Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) software by dropping a vulnerable signed Windows driver (procexp.sys) with kernel privileges to disable security solutions and take over the system
Escalates privileges by impersonating the TrustedInstaller Windows Modules Installer service to gain SYSTEM privileges
Continuously probes and disables security processes and services, preventing them from restarting
Used in Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) attacks to deploy backdoors and ransomware
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Microsoft's Process Explorer v16.32
Attack Vector: Dropping legitimate signed vulnerable drivers with kernel privileges on victim devices
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of vulnerable Windows driver procexp.sys next to Process Explorer v16.32 driver
Date of Discovery: Mid-February 2023 (newest sample compilation and use in attacks)
